hypothesis: An explicit rsqrtf followed by one Newton refinement may reduce the cost of the sqrt-and-reciprocal sequence while mitigating the approximation error that can accumulate in the serial interaction sum. The controller must validate all correctness cases, especially the largest size and extreme-mass case, before timing this candidate.
notes: Only the arithmetic for inverse distance changed. The provided kernel already accumulates acceleration directly from source masses and contains no target-mass multiply/divide pair to cancel; that structure is retained. The prior h01 and h02 candidates were incorrect at the largest size and were untimed, so this refinement is a new unvalidated candidate, not a claim of correctness or speedup.
transformations: Replace sqrtf plus reciprocal with rsqrtf and one Newton refinement for inverse distance.
Retain float32 softening, self-pair skip, source traversal and accumulation order, velocity-then-position update, and exact mass copying.
Do not enable global fast math or introduce target-mass normalization.
